result.markdown:
If you're looking to compare **Gemini 4 coding prompts, real-world generated code, and benchmark demonstrations**, I'd start with these five resources.

## Best places to compare Gemini 4 coding examples

![Google、新フロンティアモデル「Gemini 4 Argon」を発表 ― サイバー防御特化、信頼済みパートナーに限定提供｜SecondWave｜米国株・テックトレンド](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qLJ1Ih2wLQu35EDq4cW7cHuahmmQIjRL_703b6mKPsBxaU7bEPQCbaIc1nBEuqXnRsLDFxg-D1f5cpy55u2Iav1AzOZHITnSg0KTz00eyPFvj_NEX6QVnsWQBXSM0vOmX8pIwgE8ejaYJFLVMdP3T6PyY2uKZ3jmZBcLtUbCxy8u6HmzNteIcgv5gRmQ4GxJ?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Google DeepMind – Gemini 4 Benchmarks**

(Best for official benchmarks)

- Compare Gemini 4 against GPT and Claude.
- Review agentic coding and Terminal-Bench.
- Examine model evaluation methodology.

[Explore Gemini 4 benchmarks](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Vibe Code with Gemini in Google AI Studio  |  Google Codelabs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jlX1vqFG_gk2L2h7Z4VbUou21SEkZzmsFv7-Y7kfa4DbtjdSedDfXfTBItQLs0PY8iEGi8vmrwnah7_kBW219tbAWKZwd0Bko1NUGpH_F8U1WTHsTucMkeTm0SNCwLH2drvGe3jdN9IqNliOheOVjykUVxXwU3Ux2V9s6jfI3gQ68rcqjb5HOt3NKDBVn7TZ?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Awesome Gemini 4 Argon**

(Best for prompt examples)

- Hundreds of creative coding examples.
- Three.js, WebGL, SVG and browser games.
- Some original creator prompts are available.
- Model comparisons and video demonstrations.

[Browse prompts and demos on GitHub](https://github.com/sandbase-lab/awesome-gemini4-argon/blob/main/README.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Gemini 4 Argonで大きなコード移行は進む？100万トークン出力と提供条件｜石川 明](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aq6-s45dPFKr57HmD4wzIWgthpf_OlPsnw8W3G0tp_bGBl51eNIbWnlrtQX-iyDn0ZAn7H2G_CakUMtVBih3cD7niFsfOOuDafaLddXwmufyleSobpm-lRsGJaiBGVOUrtlOhQimDojJlvinWxqkA9Ly2ojtCK4j5Vj9ZrS2nrfKq19klZD2qdM3R7hIJHjQ?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Gemini 4 Carbon Prompt Collection**

- Real codebase and application examples.
- Bug fixes, tooling and research tasks.
- Same-prompt comparisons against other models.
- Examples with published prompts.

[Explore 223 coding and creative examples](https://apimodels.app/gemini-4-carbon-prompts/code?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Google AI Studio Tutorial: Complete Guide to Chat, Build, and Stream Modes | DataCamp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/pUrA6GOsXGLqwOb8-lM3gTdw-sJbVWhmgsIHBuz_pPNN8qsmZmWPYBIyxE2gWeYvWoIAvhujoTy2F19rGuvFHTFaJXX2Oca326uHV-0HZO7w_2FtmBzpX1qezNl1vjHWsWadEDy8Y83lWZDml5Rf_8DMlakJZ2IxylZmQn-l-vZnnoLXNuZBpDxZoIzWF1Ft?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Google AI Studio**

- Experiment with your own coding prompts.
- Adjust model settings.
- Test function calling and code execution.
- Generate API code.

[Open AI Studio quickstart](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/ai-studio-quickstart?hl=en&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Deploy from AI Studio to Cloud Run  |  Google Codelabs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9wNJTklISVEVHgGyKF2DuDpHszn-QY-oJAKvfTx9Pb5mV0iSa3IcVTP94kaEc1KHezkAiCcTe5ICdf0Y03AFN_QOBnNzStYUA3Pjl-qzAmPGlHDVcquWx0dQwD23UowQnQblg2y0BM3MgOVC7KNqT8J0LOFftmcyCNFyKRw6dRb4ZwGuDrqC3Evf15P6Qd4v?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Gemini 4 Creative Coding Comparisons**

- Watch four creative coding challenges.
- Compare visual quality and interaction.
- Review runtime and cost differences.
- See competing model outputs.

[Watch the coding comparison demos](https://www.artificial-intelligence.video/videos/gemini-4-argon-four-creative-coding-tasks/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which benchmarks should you compare?

| Benchmark | What it measures |
|--------|--------|
| SWE-bench / FrontierSWE | Real software engineering |
| Terminal-Bench | Command-line agent tasks |
| DeepSWE | Autonomous software engineering |
| Vibe Code Bench | Prompt-to-application coding |
| HumanEval | Code generation and correctness |


Google's published Gemini 4 evaluations include several of these categories. [deepmind.google](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[deepmind.google](https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-4-argon/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[storage.googleapis.com](https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/Model-Cards/Gemini-4-Argon-Model-Card.pdf?alt=media&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

Use three resources together\:

1. **DeepMind\:** objective benchmark comparisons.
2. **Awesome Gemini 4\:** reusable prompts and visual demos.
3. **AI Studio\:** reproduce the prompts and test the results yourself.

One important distinction: a visually impressive coding demo isn't necessarily evidence of strong software engineering performance.

## What kind of comparison are you interested in?

**Primary interest**

Coding prompts with complete source code

Live coding demos and generated applications

Benchmark scores and performance rankings

All three

---

**Models to compare**

Gemini vs Claude vs GPT

Gemini models only

Gemini vs all major coding models
